headlines.title_en: Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center: Further Expanding Scope of Cross-Regional Housing Provident Fund Loans
headlines.summary_en: Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center announced on August 29 that, to better leverage the role of the housing provident fund system and further meet homebuyers' cross-regional housing consumption needs, the scope of housing provident fund cross-regional loans will be expanded to nationwide. Contributors to the housing provident fund across the country can apply to the Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center for housing provident fund loans when purchasing homes in Nanjing. This notice takes effect from September 1, 2026.

headlines.title: 房贷延至最多40年后个人能否贷这么长？有银行称或放宽年龄限制
headlines.summary: 8月28日，住房城乡建设部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局出台一系列政策，涉及个人住房贷款、商品房开发贷款等多个领域。 新规还明确，个人房贷最长期限从30年延长到40年，为我们买房贷款提供了更多选择。 说到这里，记者要提醒一点，银行贷款是有年龄限制的。以建设银行为例，银行要求借款人年龄+贷款期限一般要小于等于75岁，最多可以放宽到80岁。所以，房贷延长到最多40年后，能不能贷这么长，您还得问问银行。记者也第一时间打听了一下，有银行表示，今后有可能会放宽个人房贷的年龄限制。（央视）

headlines.title_en: After mortgage extension to max 40 years, can individuals borrow that long? Some banks may relax age limits
headlines.summary_en: On August 28, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the People's Bank of China, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration introduced a series of policies covering personal housing loans, commercial housing development loans, and other areas. The new rules also clarify that the maximum term for personal mortgage loans is extended from 30 to 40 years, offering more choices for homebuyers. However, reporters remind that banks impose age limits on loans. For example, China Construction Bank requires that the borrower's age plus the loan term generally not exceed 75 years, with a maximum extension to 80. So, with mortgages extended to up to 40 years, whether such long terms are available depends on the bank. Reporters quickly checked and found some banks indicating they may relax mortgage age limits in the future. (CCTV)

headlines.summary_en: On the evening of August 28, China Post Savings Bank Co., Ltd. held its 2026 interim results conference. At the meeting, Xu Xueming, Vice President of Postal Savings Bank, stated that looking ahead to the full year and beyond, affected by weak credit demand, large bond investment repricing spreads, and limited room for deposit cost declines, net interest margins still face downward pressure. headlines.title: 王毅同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月29日讯，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅29日同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话。王毅表示，中方对尼一揽子援助正在落实，包括紧急现汇援助和人道主义援助。中方提供的救灾物资即将运抵加德满都。中方隧道救援专家兵分两路，奔赴灾区和加德满都驰援。中方已同尼方分享灾区影像、卫星和水文数据等重要信息，包括上游堰塞湖预警信息。对在中方一侧滞留的尼泊尔公民，中方已作出妥善安排，将协助他们尽快返尼，感谢并希望尼方继续救助转移在尼的中国公民。中尼是山水相连、命运与共的共同体。面对灾情，两国要坚定站在一起，携手应对，共克时艰，以实际行动诠释跨越喜马拉雅的传统友谊。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi holds phone call with Nepalese Foreign Minister Dr. Arzu Rana Deuba
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 29 - Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, spoke by phone with Nepali Foreign Minister Shishir on the 29th. Wang Yi said China's package of assistance to Nepal is being implemented, including emergency cash aid and humanitarian assistance. Relief supplies provided by China are about to arrive in Kathmandu. Chinese tunnel rescue experts have split into two teams to rush to the disaster zone and Kathmandu. China has shared important information with Nepal, including disaster zone imagery, satellite and hydrological data, and early warnings on upstream barrier lakes. For Nepali citizens stranded on the Chinese side, China has made proper arrangements to help them return to Nepal as soon as possible, and expressed gratitude and hope that Nepal will continue to rescue and transfer Chinese citizens in Nepal. China and Nepal are a community sharing mountains and rivers and a common future. In the face of the disaster, the two countries must stand firmly together, respond jointly, and overcome difficulties, demonstrating the traditional friendship across the Himalayas through concrete actions.

headlines.title_en: CCB President Zhang Yi: Enhance mortgage coverage and service levels
headlines.summary_en: Zhang Yi, president of China Construction Bank, said on August 28 at the bank's 2026 interim results conference that looking to the second half, the bank is confident in China's long-term economic fundamentals but is also clearly aware of challenges ahead and will maintain strategic focus. He mentioned full support for expanding domestic demand, industrial upgrading, and the growth of private and small-micro enterprises, enhancing cross-border integrated service capabilities, closely following national consumption-boosting policies, improving mortgage coverage and service levels, deeply participating in major consumption-promotion activities, and deepening inclusive livelihood financial services. (Shanghai Securities News)

It was the first decline in 16 months, following a drop in April last year. Prices were flat that May, then climbed steadily for 13 months starting in June.

headlines.title_en: ChangXin Memory Technologies sues US Department of Defense
headlines.summary_en: According to comprehensive foreign media reports, on August 28 local time, Chinese chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Defense demanding removal from a blacklist. Per Bloomberg, CXMT said its chips are designed for civilian and commercial use, not military, and claimed it was wrongly blacklisted. The suit was filed with the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also named as a defendant. In a statement after filing, CXMT said it is not a military enterprise and that its reputation and business interests have been continuously damaged since its initial blacklisting in January 2025, adding that the action was taken to protect commercial interests. Per Reuters, the Defense Department said in a statement that 'as a matter of policy, the department does not comment on pending or ongoing litigation.'

headlines.summary: 交通银行副行长周万阜在交通银行2026年半年度业绩说明会上表示，从存款期限结构看，定期化趋势仍然没有明显的改变，存款的增量中大部分还是来自于定期存款。周万阜同时强调，交通银行今年的活期存款已实现同比多增，带动了整个存款成本下降。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Bank of Communications Vice President Zhou Wanfu: This year, demand deposits saw a year-on-year increase
headlines.summary_en: Zhou Wanfu, vice president of Bank of Communications, said at the bank's 2026 interim results briefing that in terms of deposit term structure, the trend toward fixed deposits remains largely unchanged, with most deposit growth still coming from time deposits. Zhou also stressed that BoCom's demand deposits have grown more year on year this year, helping lower overall deposit costs. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 上半年全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户 同比增长7.0%
headlines.summary: 市场监管总局今天（29日）公布数据显示，上半年，全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户，同比增长7.0%。从投资区域看，出口大省、沿边省份外商投资企业增长“双轮驱动”。上半年，海南、山东、广东、江苏等出口大省新设外商投资企业增速分别为38.6%、15.2%、8.1%、6.8%；黑龙江、内蒙古、广西、吉林等沿边省份新设外商投资企业增速分别达到79.5%、29.1%、16.6%、12.0%。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: In H1, 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide, up 7.0% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation today (29th) released data showing that in the first half of the year, 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide, up 7.0% year-on-year. By investment region, growth in foreign-invested enterprises in major export provinces and border provinces showed a 'dual-engine' drive. In the first half, new foreign-invested enterprises in export-heavy provinces such as Hainan, Shandong, Guangdong, and Jiangsu grew 38.6%, 15.2%, 8.1%, and 6.8% respectively; in border provinces like Heilongjiang, Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, and Jilin, growth reached 79.5%, 29.1%, 16.6%, and 12.0% respectively. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 澳门特区政府心系西藏吉隆灾情，捐助3000万支持灾害救援及善后工作
headlines.summary: 因西藏日喀则市吉隆县遭受泥石流灾害，澳门特区政府决定通过澳门基金会向西藏自治区捐助三千万人民币，支持当地的救援及善后工作。同舟共济，血浓于水，一方有难，八方支援。除捐助外，澳门特区政府将尽力提供医疗救援等灾区所需的各项支援，积极支持相关善后工作。（大湾区之声）

headlines.title_en: Macao SAR Government Concerned About Tibet Gyirong Disaster, Donates 30 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts
headlines.summary_en: Due to a mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, the Macao SAR government has decided to donate 30 million RMB to the Tibet Autonomous Region through the Macao Foundation to support local rescue and recovery efforts. Standing together in solidarity, blood is thicker than water, and when one region is in trouble, all regions support. In addition to the donation, the Macao SAR government will make every effort to provide medical rescue and other disaster-zone support needed, actively assisting related recovery work. (Greater Bay Area Voice)
